value.message: Provide environmentName in the trigger body or configure the EnvironmentName variable.

inputs.recordPurpose: Single authoritative source of truth and complete reference record
inputs.informationPolicy: No filtering, reduction, redaction, masking, validation, or omission of retrieved URL or flow information.
inputs.securityClassification: Restricted - complete inventory including signed callback URLs, definitions, connections, owners, and raw action results. Run-history only: not emailed, not written to a list, not returned to a caller.

inputs.informationPolicy: Every retrieved field except the signature. Callback URLs appear with sig=<CREDENTIAL_REMOVED> and the signature length beside them. Flow definitions, connection references, owner records and raw action results are omitted, not masked.
inputs.securityClassification: Internal - no credential. Safe to attach to mail, file, or hand to a reviewer.
inputs.restrictedTierLocation: Compose_Restricted_Extraction_Result, in this run history only.

parameters.emailMessage/Subject: @{concat('Endpoint inventory — ', variables('EnvironmentName'), ' — ', string(variables('FlowsFoundCount')), ' of ', string(length(outputs('Compose_Expanded_Flow_Registry'))), ' records retrieved')}
parameters.emailMessage/Body:
Endpoint inventory for environment @{variables('EnvironmentName')}, run at @{utcNow()}.

  • Registry records: @{length(outputs('Compose_Expanded_Flow_Registry'))}, across @{length(union(body('Select_Application_Workflow_Ids'),json('[]')))} application workflows
  • Retrieved from the tenant: @{variables('FlowsFoundCount')}
  • Not retrieved or not processed: @{variables('FlowsNotFoundCount')}

The attachment carries every retrieved field except the signature: callback URLs appear with sig=<CREDENTIAL_REMOVED> and the signature length beside them. The complete unredacted record stays in this run history and is not attached.
